title: Using Integral Additivity and Linearity
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Given that int_1^5 f(x) dx = 10 and int_3^5 f(x) dx = 4, evaluate int_1^3 (2f(x) - 3) dx.

steps.title: Apply Interval Additivity to Find int_1^3 f
steps.mathExpression: \int_1^5 f(x) dx = \int_1^3 f(x) dx + \int_3^5 f(x) dx \implies 10 = \int_1^3 f(x) dx + 4 \implies \int_1^3 f(x) dx = 6
steps.explanation: Subtract integral on [3, 5] from integral on [1, 5].

steps.title: Evaluate Constant and Total
steps.explanation: Evaluate integral of constant 3 over length 2.
